items.t: A third weekend of protests in France as youth-led rallies sweep Europe
items.x: Thousands of young protesters have taken to the streets across France for a third weekend, protesting over living costs and education.

items.t: Houdini's centennial spotlight: A newly published essay and a fresh fight over when and how he died
items.x: Harry Houdini died 100 years ago. Now, a rare essay by the escape artist has been published for the first time, shedding light on his early influences.

items.t: Fort Myers woman accused of smoking crack cocaine in public park wanted for missing court
items.x: A Fort Myers woman is wanted on a new warrant after failing to appear in court following an arrest in which police said she was smoking crack cocaine in a public park.

items.t: Domestic incident leads to barricade situation in Southwest Cape Coral
items.x: Police are surrounding a home in Southwest Cape Coral at a very active scene late Friday night.

items.t: ‘I Voted’ sticker creator talks about how it started
items.x: The “I Voted” sticker given to people who cast ballots began with one woman, Janet Boudreau, who designed it after seeing a local county hand out a different sticker on Election Day.

items.t: Life without parole for man in deadly North Jetty Park shooting
items.x: Franklin Raybon Jr. sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole.

items.t: Police corporal killed in ‘freak’ motorcycle crash remembered by wife, father
items.x: An Alabama woman says she just had two and a half weeks with her husband before he was taken away from her in a motorcycle crash.

items.t: Marco Island police issue Halloween safety reminder after DUI arrest
items.x: Marco Island police arrested a driver for DUI after observing a vehicle being driven on its rim, prompting a safety message for Halloween weekend.

items.t: Man wanted in Lee County after missing court date in drug possession case
items.x: A man is wanted after he failed to show up to his court date following a drug possession arrest.

items.t: Best of The Bay Music Fest canceled Sunday due to forecast
items.x: Plans are underway to reschedule the popular all-day music festival for spring 2027.

items.t: Florida Highway Patrol arrests most wanted suspect in 2024 crash that killed 3
items.x: On Thursday, troopers with the Florida Highway Patrol arrested a fugitive who was wanted on vehicular homicide charges in a 2024 vehicle crash that killed three people.

items.t: Matlacha store owner says artist vandalized mural after being fired
items.x: A Matlacha business owner claims an artist painted over a mural on her store after being fired, leaving a message and causing thousands of dollars in damages.

items.x: McCord is carrying on a family legacy of firefighting.

items.x: The event will run from 6 to 9 p.m.

items.t: Halloween pumpkins can have a scary impact on the planet; how these pigs are helping
items.x: Each year, around 1.3 billion pounds of pumpkins are sent to the landfill, according to the EPA.

items.t: A flurry of last-minute legal developments could impact midterm elections
items.x: A criminal probe involving one of the closest Senate races of the year is underway, while several legal battles continue over ballots from suspected non-citizens.

items.t: Man posing as Amazon delivery driver accused of stealing multiple packages from neighborhood
items.x: A Portland man was arrested after allegedly stealing packages in Lake Oswego.

items.t: 1 dead, 6 injured in shooting at California Spirit Halloween
items.x: One person was killed and six others were injured after a shooting at a Spirit Halloween store in California.

items.t: There's new guidance on menopause symptoms like hot flashes. What women need to know
items.x: For the first time in a dozen years, a leading OB-GYN group has updated its guidance on managing hot flashes, night sweats, sleep changes and other disruptive symptoms that often come with menopause.

items.t: Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Ukraine after localized ceasefire
items.x: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held territory Saturday in a major rescue operation carried out under the most significant truce since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine 4½ years ago.
